rules.6.4.11: Lengthening in the designated sarvanāmasthāna environment, except the address condition. For Uṇādi formations the named list governs. When addressed, the singular in this table uses -aḥ, as in he kartaḥ. The cited dual and plural with he retain the ordinary dual/plural readings.
rules.1.1.43: The five initial sup endings receive the sarvanāmasthāna designation for the selected non-neuter stems. The sg, du and pl columns have independent source locators.
rules.6.1.111: Ablative and genitive singular -uḥ for these ṛ-final stems.
rules.nearby_cases: Long ṝ in the accusative plural and genitive plural has its own environment. The inherited lexical long a in bhrā-, jāmā-, mā- is distinct from the diagnostic vowel directly before r in the strong stem.

model.pre_final_ṛ: retain the whole initial factor, including retroflex stops in neṣṭṛ and tvaṣṭṛ

potṛ.decision: Use the archive only for the inflection. Uṇādi and the lexicon supply the priest sense. The archive gloss calls this a grandson.
